{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm the clean column is numeric
print(sales['revenue_clean'].dtype)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_count = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99): {internal_test_count}")

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders from completed orders
completed_valid = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = completed_valid['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
